Use case: scientific-educational. Create a finished Chinese technical infographic for a WeChat article, first in a four-image series on a 256-GPU cluster. Raster illustration generated by GPT, exceptionally accurate text and uncluttered connections. Portrait-friendly 4:3 canvas about 1600x1200 or higher. Warm off-white background #F7F9FC, dark navy titles, rounded white cards, restrained blue and teal, soft orange accent. Crisp flat editorial style, large Chinese sans serif text, generous spacing, no branding or watermarks, no small illegible footnotes. Title exactly “GPU 怎样跨服务器通信”. Subtitle exactly “机内走 NVLink，跨机走计算网卡”.
Layout: two equal side-by-side large cards labeled “服务器 A” and “服务器 B”. Within EACH server card, exactly 8 small green GPU tiles numbered GPU0 through GPU7 arranged in two rows of four, a central blue internal interconnect rectangle labeled “NVLink / NVSwitch”, and a separate lower orange rectangle labeled “计算网卡 NIC” with line below “8 个 400G 计算端口”. Connect the eight GPU tiles to the internal interconnect as a simplified internal connectivity drawing. Indicate GPU access to compute NIC through a distinct simplified line labeled “PCIe 通路（示意）”; do NOT imply that NIC plugs directly into NVLink/NVSwitch. Put the network card below GPUs linked from GPU side, not from the NVSwitch box. Between/below the two server cards draw a separate pale blue block labeled “外部计算网络” and “RoCEv2 或 IB”. Both servers’ NIC rectangles connect to this block with thick blue bidirectional lines. No outside cable goes directly to a GPU or an NVSwitch block. Bottom explanation in two large short notes: “机内：GPU 通过高速互联交换数据” and “跨机：GPU 经网卡与外部网络通信”. Each external broad line is schematic bundle, caption “外部连线为端口组示意”. Accurate Chinese, no protocol configuration instructions, no claims of automatic full throughput. Balance beauty and technical clarity.

Create a new clean Chinese beginner technical infographic, light offwhite, navy headings, flat rounded rectangles, large type, minimal straight lines. Title “Rail-Optimized：分两步看懂接线”. Two stacked panels, no crossings anywhere, no 3D switch icons. Top panel titled “① 一台服务器，8 个网口分别接 8 台 Leaf”. Draw exactly EIGHT equally spaced simple Leaf boxes in ONE ROW, labeled Leaf 0, Leaf 1, Leaf 2, Leaf 3, Leaf 4, Leaf 5, Leaf 6, Leaf 7. Below them ONE large pale server rectangle labeled 服务器 A; inside along its top edge exactly EIGHT smaller NIC boxes in one row labeled NIC0 NIC1 NIC2 NIC3 NIC4 NIC5 NIC6 NIC7, aligned directly under corresponding Leaf. Draw exactly EIGHT short STRAIGHT VERTICAL lines, each between matching Leaf and NIC. Colors percolumn coral/orange/mustard/green/teal/blue/violet/pink. No diagonal line. No other server in top panel. Bottom panel titled “② 只看 Rail 0：不同服务器的 NIC0 接同一台 Leaf”. ONE coral wide rectangle topcenter labeled Leaf 0 containing exactly3distinct little outputports spaced left/center/right. Under it exactly THREE small server cards horizontally, 服务器 A, 服务器 B, 服务器 C, each with ONE NIC box labeled NIC0. Draw exactly THREE short VERTICAL coral lines, each from its own Leaf port straight down to one NIC0. Leaf0 top rectangle spans the combined horizontal width of3servercards to permit entirely verticalconnections. Small text “其余 Rail 1～7，按同样规则连接”. Footer “每条线代表 1 条 400G 逻辑链路；完整 SU 接入 32 台服务器”. Total11lines acrossbothpanels, no crossedlines, no bus, no linebetweenpanels, no duplicatedNICs. This is a ChineseWeChat article graphic, mobile legibility paramount, portrait4:5.

Use case: scientific-educational. Generate finished Chinese comparison infographic for WeChat. 4:3 canvas about1600x1200 or higher. Warm off-white #F7F9FC, navy type, rounded panels, flat precise educational editorial, no logo or watermark. Title exactly “什么是 1∶1 无收敛”. Subtitle “看上下行总带宽，不看端口是否插满”.
Two equally sized side-by-side panels, left green/teal good capacity titled “1∶1 无收敛”, right orange titled “2∶1 收敛”. In each panel a central rounded box labeled “Leaf”. Below Leaf a wide band labeled “服务器” connects vertically to Leaf, with exact text “下联 32 × 400G” and “12.8 Tb/s”. Above Leaf is a band labeled “上层网络”. LEFT top link same width as bottom, labels “上联 32 × 400G” and “12.8 Tb/s”. RIGHT top link half width as bottom, labels “上联 16 × 400G” and “6.4 Tb/s”. Use thick schematic link bands rather than drawing32tinycables; captions specify “线束宽度示意带宽”. Bidirectional capability conveyed by small two-way arrows, no suggestion that links are physically one-way. Left bottom outcome “上下行带宽相等”; right outcome “同时向上发送时，出口容量减半”. A bottom full-width note in clear large Chinese: “1∶1 说明带宽没有超售，不保证任何负载下都不拥堵”. No fabricated packetloss or performance percentages other than exact ratio. Each panel must have exactly one Leaf, one upper band, one lower server band. Precise numbers, distinguish left32up vs right16up both32down.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a premium accurate Chinese topology infographic for a WeChat beginner technical article. Portrait-ish 4:5 highresolution roughly1600x2000. Same series style: warm off-white #F7F9FC, dark navy headline, flat rounded white cards, soft blue Spines, eight colored Leaves (0 coral,1 orange,2mustard,3green,4teal,5blue,6violet,7pink). No watermark or logos. Title “完整的 256 卡计算网络”. Subtitle “32 台服务器 · 8 台 Leaf · 4 台 Spine”.
Top layer exactly FOUR Spine switches horizontal labelled “Spine 0” “Spine 1” “Spine 2” “Spine 3”. Under each label small legible “64 × 400G”. Middle layer exactly EIGHT Leaf switches horizontal labelled Leaf0 through Leaf7 with respective Railcolors. Connect EVERY Leaf to EVERY Spine with one thin schematic line per pair (32 drawn upper lines), grouping/bundling visually where necessary but no missing links. ONE represented line stands for8parallel400Glogical links, not1. Large callout between layers “每对 Leaf—Spine：8 × 400G” and secondary “每台 Leaf 上联：4 × 8 = 32 条”. No horizontal switch-to-switch links at same layer.
Bottom layer a large framed group “1 个 SU：32 台服务器 × 8 张 GPU = 256 卡”. Within it, show three illustrative server cards labelled “服务器 01” “服务器 02” “… 服务器 32”, each with compute ports0–7 matching Railcolors. Because full lower wiring would be crowded, draw EIGHT schematic downlink bundles from the eight Leaves to a labelled overview strip at top of SU box, each bundle corresponding exactly toitsRail and use tag “32 × 400G”. This strip MUST be visually indicated as a grouping annotation not a switch: dashed outline and no device icon, label “同编号 NIC 连接汇总（不是交换设备）”. The eight bundle descriptions mean Leaf0 connects all32NIC0 etc, not one leaf to allNICtypes. Beneath server cards put note “每台服务器的 NIC0～NIC7，分别接 Leaf0～Leaf7”. This is an aggregated physical topology drawing, carefully distinguish schematic bundles fromactual wires.
Below full topology add a concise three-row count card in large legible text:
“每台 Leaf：32 口下联 + 32 口上联”
“服务器—Leaf：256 条 400G”
“Leaf—Spine：256 条 400G”
Footer “所有数量按 400G 逻辑链路计算；线束不等于一根成品线缆”. Do not draw Core, do not draw extraSpines, do not show GPU directlyconnectedtoLeaf, do not call this RoCE-certified or vendor official. Include “RoCEv2 或 IB · 端口容量示例” as small subtitle. Limit decoration, prioritize accurate topology and readability. Use schematic aggregation intentionally rather than 512individualcables.
